sourceRules.governance: active persistence batch -> active published assignment-governance-v3
sourceRules.workspace: current workspace manifest -> current workspace-version artifact
sourceRules.principal: orgmaster_contract.v_active_principal_accounts_v1 plus current workspace active employee; one exact typed human_personal or human_privileged mapping is required for employee business assignments
sourceRules.admission: current typed Principal/Employee admission; typedAccountVersion is canonical mapping_version and securityBindingStamp is null because no owner security-stamp contract exists
sourceRules.catalog: published FMS application-contract release with contentSha256, artifactSha256, source draft provenance, and publishedBy Principal/Employee bound to the authenticated import actor
sourceRules.assignments: active current-scope rows only; revoked rows are absent and never receive a fabricated revokedAt
sourceRules.grants: explicit exact-principal financial-management-system catalog/workflow operations with a non-empty grant id only; Employee business assignments never create protected grants
sourceRules.candidates: authorized workflow candidates only; an active typed human_personal or human_privileged Principal/Employee must have an effective FMS business assignment
